findings.before: Family=Documentation names a structural area while Component=Document Identity identifies actual component membership. Type=Architecture is already valid. Received V1.0 R0,Canonical/Baseline1.0,English and Author=Arnaldo Figueira are declarations without supplied approval/selection events.
findings.proposal: Use Family=Document Identity and matching Component=Document Identity;retain Type=Architecture by component architectural responsibility and stable DF-DID-001/path. Preserve original author/header/history;attribute actual successor contribution separately from authorization/review/approval. Assess actual written contracts for Version,increment Revision monotonically and use Draft/Baseline Not assigned;no Class or historical approval invented.
findings.closure_criterion: Header and rationale follow canonical membership/four Types with stable identity and preserved attribution/history;future working successor inherits neither Canonical approval nor Baseline membership.

findings.before: Identity is stated for documents throughout their entire existence without normalized/functional applicability. Templates possess their own identities;Relationships connect identities and Graph represents identities as entities/relationships without distinguishing document IDs from other endpoint or Template entity identities.
findings.proposal: Apply all-location README.md/CHANGELOG.md/ArchitecturalMilestones.md normalization exclusion while retaining content/reference/history/hash checks. Define normalized logical document identity separately from physical files,exact editions,descriptors,Template definitions/instances and other entity-domain keys. Use document identity for document endpoints/nodes;other entities use their own qualified contracts. Do not assign document or Metadata Element IDs to excluded files or every entity.
findings.closure_criterion: All identity/scope/consumer clauses respect normalized applicability and distinct entity kinds without extending document-ID obligations to functional files,Template entities or graph edges by implication.

findings.before: Unique/permanent/immutable/globally understandable identity is unqualified in this architecture. No Domain+Identifier boundary or exact-edition reference distinction is given. Permanent validity can be misread as guaranteed resolution/retrieval despite changed paths,retirement or missing history;absolute identity independence does not address explicitly authorized necessary representation migration.
findings.proposal: Define logical identity under a declared Domain+Identifier allocation/preservation contract. Within the DF corpus use adopted DF-SSS-NNN as stable allocation series independent of current Family/Type/path/Version/Revision;domain uniqueness is not bare-string global uniqueness or implicit new-domain registration. Preserve valid identities through normal evolution,never reuse retired allocations,and distinguish canonical references/aliases from new identities. Necessary schema/ID migration already authorized requires explicit previous/new mapping,collision/reference/history/edition/consumer checks and coordinated reconciliation;do not rewrite immutable snapshots or broadly permit arbitrary identity changes. No migration/allocation occurs in this localized UPDATE. Historical reference preservation differs from proved resolver availability.
findings.closure_criterion: The architecture scopes uniqueness/permanence and exact references,retains valid IDs/non-reuse and corpus allocation boundaries,qualifies real resolution evidence and explicit necessary migration without claiming completed DID schema integration or silently changing identity/history.

findings.before: §3 correctly says the component does not assign identifiers,while DID-014 §3 and README say it defines,assigns,preserves and governs identities. §5 maps Discovery/Governance structural areas as components and conflates version control with documentary governance. Contract ownership and actual execution are not consistently separated across peers.
findings.proposal: Keep Document Identity as owner of identity/allocation/preservation/validation/governance contracts,not an operational assigning service. DMS/tool/manual executors perform allocation,registry,reference and transition operations;CMS governs changes in its own scope. Reconcile the out-of-scope table using actual capability owners or explicitly typed area/external roles:Registry versus Discovery,Workflow/Policies/Reviews/Baselines versus Governance,and source-control adapters/commits versus document edition semantics. Preserve peer assignment claims as pending discrepancy;do not silently edit/certify README or DID-014.
findings.closure_criterion: Source responsibilities and out-of-scope mappings consistently distinguish domain owner,contract,capability area and operational executor without invented services or a false claim of completed peer reconciliation.

findings.before: §2 tree records allocation and §8 lists documentary foundation references under Dependencies,while §9 gives untyped provider/consumer relationships. DID-009 §§5/10 states Metadata depends on Document Identity and no consumer dependency;README explicitly states Document Identity depends on Metadata for descriptive concepts,creating apparent reciprocal required declarations that remain unresolved.
findings.proposal: Type allocation,documentary authority,semantic references,projection and required consumer→provider contracts separately. State actual scope/source editions/interfaces and Layers support/same-Layer/prohibited-cycle rules. Preserve the apparent Metadata↔Document Identity declarations visibly with their stated uses pending owner/context reconciliation;do not relabel a genuine requirement as navigation or claim universal independence/global acyclicity. Distinguish key semantics from descriptive-record contracts and avoid forcing every component through Registry/Graph. Baselines needs logical identity plus exact edition/context evidence,not identity alone.
findings.closure_criterion: All actual relation meanings/scope/direction are explicit;the received allocation view is not a runtime chain,required contracts/cycles remain visible and reciprocal peer declarations retain unresolved evidence without fabricated cycle-free implementation or concealed mandatory edges.

findings.before: Architecture scope includes identity lifecycle but does not distinguish immutable identity key from mutable identity-record state,document Status or exact edition facts. DID-004 offers Active/Archived/Deprecated;DID-006 offers Unassigned/Assigned/Preserved/Retired. DID-005 lists Domain/Identifier/optional references0..N,DID-003 reference cardinality1:N,and DID-014 adds mandatory Identity State/Canonical Reference under a different schema.
findings.proposal: Separate stable Domain+Identifier meaning,mutable assignment/preservation/retirement evidence,external reference associations and exact document editions/lifecycle/maturity/snapshot membership. Record the actual State/Status/cardinality/mandatory-reference schema conflicts and responsible scheduled owners;do not invent a canonical merged schema,Metadata catalog fields or transition graph in this overview. Unassigned describes a pre-allocation subject,not an already assigned key;retirement preserves reservations/history but does not guarantee live content retrieval. Reconcile actual full schema/lifecycle requirements in DID-003/004/005/006/010/014 cycles before declaring integrated conformance.
findings.closure_criterion: Identity versus identity-record/document lifecycle/reference concepts are explicit and all compared schema/state/cardinality conflicts remain accurately recorded with pending owner reconciliation;no guessed mandatory field/state/Profile or universal transition graph is certified.

findings.before: §10 absolutely prohibits implementation details and requires serialization/implementation independence;§7 requires globally understandable identity and §12 says principles guarantee stable unique permanent identities. Conceptual independence,necessary logical representation/allocation rules and actual implementation/resolution evidence are not distinguished.
findings.proposal: Retain technology-neutral architectural definitions while allowing explicit logical syntax,domain/allocation,canonicalization,reference and integration contracts as requirements rather than generation/storage code. Actual adapters/representations/executors need scoped conformance evidence. Preserve compatible meaning where feasible;necessary contract changes require impact/transition/version checks with monotonic Revision. Technology independence guarantees neither every-format compatibility,resolver availability nor successful unique assignment.
findings.closure_criterion: Constraint/characteristic/conclusion wording distinguishes logical requirements from implementation choices and demonstrated outcomes,with controlled necessary evolution rather than blanket harmlessness or universal independence guarantees.

findings.before: The document calls itself architectural specification/canonical model and says it establishes principles that guarantee identity properties. §11 claims the complete specification is distributed across a future-document list,though source presence and received Canonical headers do not prove complete coherent implementation or source-role conformance.
findings.proposal: State explicit architecture responsibility/applicable contracts and actual examined-edition/evidence limits;source Type/title/status does not establish approval,publication,Baseline or deployed correctness. Identify supplied versus required/complete roles and actual pending peer conflicts;use ARC-007 organization/conformance and RVW evidence. Actual attribution,authorization,review,validation,ownership and approval differ;later bytes require independent assessment without inherited outcomes or responsibility for consequences of a changed product.
findings.closure_criterion: All completeness/authority/quality claims are evidence-bounded and actual intended requirements remain distinct from peer/global conformance or implemented outcomes;no review/UPDATE itself closes global identity/collision/graph records.

findings.before: Eight §6 principle labels mix common design ideas and component-specific identity constraints without actual AP IDs or role qualification. Single Responsibility/Separation of Concerns are not the exact owner AP-006 title;Repository/Format/Implementation Independence are scoped applications rather than newly registered framework APs.
findings.proposal: Preserve all eight received labels with explicit role/owner mapping:primary ownership to AP-006,technology/representation independence to AP-003,identity stability to AP-010,and canonical representation to actual DID domain contracts. Do not fabricate AP IDs or imply complete24-principle conformance;reference actual applicable clauses/evidence boundaries and preserve local identity-specific constraints as such.
findings.closure_criterion: Each received principle label has an accurate owner/role mapping and selected scope;framework AP titles/IDs are real,no new AP or automatic implementation compliance invented.
